CLI sequences identify actual recorded executions, not command-string mentions or quoted documentation. Construction review requires the concatenation finding and retained/source-resolved unresolved path; ordinary mention is optional. Authorization is separate from construction provenance. The archive is verified against the final recorded snapshot inventory for each run; the command log remains evidence of reported shell activity, not complete OS-level capture.
